items.originalTitle: Daniel Ricciardo opens door to racing return with Max Verstappen at Le Mans
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo has said he would consider a one-off appearance at the Le Mans 24 Hours and named his former Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen as his first choice to share a car with.
detailZh: 里卡多考虑与维斯塔潘搭档出战勒芒
里卡多透露，他会考虑在勒芒24小时耐力赛中进行一次性复出参赛
里卡多，红牛车队第三车手，与马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多透露，他会考虑在勒芒24小时耐力赛中进行一次性的亮相，并点名他的前红牛队友马克斯·维斯塔潘作为他首选的共享赛车人选。
这位澳大利亚车手自2024年新加坡大奖赛后退出F1以来便未再参赛，但在参加《F1超越格子旗》节目时，这位八次大奖赛冠军得主表示，他希望有机会按照自己的方式结束赛车生涯。
“一年前，我会说我再也不会戴上头盔了。我结束了。就这样。但内心深处有个声音告诉我，能按照自己的方式为赛车生涯画上句号，那会很好。
“所以去做这样一件事，当我摘下头盔时，我是面带微笑、快乐的，也许那就是我需要的最后一点释怀。”
丹尼尔·里卡多与马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
里卡多表示，完整的一个赛季仍然无法吸引他，但在勒芒的一次性出战是他觉得自己可以去做的事情。对这位前红牛车手而言，吸引力的一部分在于与队友共享一辆赛车，而不是像在F1中那样作为对手相互竞争。
“与其他车手共享一辆赛车，并且真正拥有可以分享数据、互相帮助的队友，”他继续说道。“我会很享受这一点。那会是我真正喜欢的那种驾驶方式和伙伴情谊。”
当被问及他希望在耐力赛中与谁共享一辆赛车时，里卡多补充道：“我不想给他施加压力，但显然马克斯是一个会高居名单前列的名字。”
“我们显然在2018年谈过红牛以及‘如果会怎样’，而我当时正试图在职业生涯末期回到那支车队。所以也许那是一种方式，我们可以，是的，我说给大家他们想要的。”
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo opens door to racing return with Max Verstappen at Le Mans
Daniel Ricciardo has revealed he would consider a one-off return to racing at the Le Mans 24 Hours
Daniel Ricciardo, Third Driver, Red Bull Racing and Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo has revealed he would consider a one-off appearance at the Le Mans 24 Hours and named his former Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen as his first choice to share a car with.

The Australian driver has not raced since his F1 exit after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix, but during an appearance on the F1 Beyond the Grid, the eight-time grand prix winner said he would like the chance to end his racing career on his own terms.

“A year ago, I would have said I will never put a helmet on again. I’m done. That’s it. But there is something there where I’m like, it’d be nice for me to also finish a racing career a bit more on my terms.
"So to do something that, when I take the helmet off, I’m smiling and happy, and maybe that’s the last bit of closure I need."
Daniel Ricciardo & Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Ricciardo said a full season still did not appeal to him, but that a one-off outing at Le Mans was something he could see himself doing. Part of the appeal for the former Red Bull driver is sharing a car with his team-mates, rather than competing against them as rivals in F1.

"To share a car with other drivers and to actually have real team-mates to share data and help out," he continued. "I would just enjoy it. It would be the form of driving and companionship that I would really enjoy."
Asked who he would love to share a car with in the endurance race, Ricciardo added: "I don’t want to put pressure on him, but obviously Max is a name that would be high on the list.

"We talked about Red Bull obviously in 2018 and ‘what if’, and I was trying to get back at the team at the end of my career. So maybe that’s a way that we could, yeah, I say give the people what they want."

items.summaryZh: 里卡多承认他希望留在红牛车队而不是在2018赛季结束后离开，加入雷诺车队。

items.originalTitle: Daniel Ricciardo reveals major regret over 2018 Red Bull departure
detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多透露对2018年离开红牛的重大遗憾
丹尼尔·里卡多承认他希望留在红牛而不是在2019年加入雷诺
丹尼尔·里卡多，红牛车队支持西海岸鹰队在AFL决赛中
对于红牛车迷来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
丹尼尔·里卡多承认他希望自己没有在2018赛季结束后离开红牛一级方程式车队。
这位澳大利亚人在红牛车队赢得了七个大奖赛，但他在离开车队并加入雷诺车队参加2019赛季时震惊了所有人，留下马克斯·维斯塔潘成为车队无可争议的主车手。这位荷兰人在2021年连续赢得了四个世界冠军，而里卡多在2021年蒙扎为麦凯伦赢得了一场比赛后，他的F1生涯在2024年结束。
在Beyond The Grid播客中，里卡多确认车队希望他留下，并承认回顾过去，他会做出不同的选择。
“如果我要简要回答，是的。我想我会希望留下，对吧？我说我想，这听起来并不令人信服。我希望留下，但，我不知道，当时我离开是因为我觉得自己有点过于舒适，有点自满。我认为有一种尝试新事物的渴望。所以我不知道，这并不是黑白分明。”
这位37岁的车手表示，这次转会让他失去了可能是他赢得世界冠军的最佳机会。
“如果我能成为世界冠军，是的，那是我最好的机会吗？是的，绝对是的。所以从这个角度来看，我想，‘是的，我真的很想了解如果我留下会是什么样子。’我不想说我还在为此困扰，但这是我感兴趣的一个未知数，我想知道那会怎样发展。”
里卡多小心翼翼地没有声称他会打败维斯塔潘，他说那样做是不公平的。但他坚持当时他仍然处于最佳状态，这由他在摩纳哥大奖赛中的胜利和那年他在墨西哥的杆位证明。
丹尼尔·里卡多，麦凯轮车队，在迈阿密开幕式舞台上拍照，站在麦凯轮赛车公司首席执行官扎克·布朗和麦凯轮车手兰多·诺里斯面前。
“我不怀疑自己保持与马克斯竞争的能力，”他说。“从那时起，很明显，是的，我的职业生涯经历了一些……河流有点风大且波涛汹涌。所以，是的，那是一个转折点。”
他补充说：“如果我能再次经历它，我会留下吗？我对会发生什么绝对好奇吗？是的，答案是肯定的。所以如果你想要称之为遗憾、好奇或者其他什么，那么我会说我有。”
里卡多后来回到了红牛车队，先是作为2023年的预备车手，然后为它的第二支车队赛车，在2024年新加坡大奖赛之后，由于在车队的不稳定时期，他被淘汰了。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo reveals major regret over 2018 Red Bull departure
Daniel Ricciardo has admitted he wishes he had stayed at Red Bull rather than joining Renault in 2019
Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing supports The West Coast Eagles in the AFL Final
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Daniel Ricciardo has admitted he wishes he had stayed at the Red Bull Formula 1 team rather than leaving at the end of the 2018 season.

The Australian won seven grands prix with Red Bull, but shocked everyone when he left the team and joined Renault for 2019, leaving Max Verstappen as the team’s undisputed lead driver. The Dutchman went on to win four consecutive world titles from 2021, while Ricciardo won just one more race - for McLaren at Monza in 2021 - before his F1 career ended in 2024.
Speaking on the Beyond The Grid podcast, the Australian confirmed the team had wanted him to stay, and admitted that, looking back, he would have done things differently.

“If I’m to answer it shortly, yes. I guess I wish I would have stayed, right? I say I guess, that doesn’t sound convincing. I wish I would have stayed but, I don’t know, also at the time I left because I felt I was getting a bit comfortable, a bit complacent. I think there was a desire to try something else. So I don’t know, it’s not that black and white.”
The 37-year-old said the move had cost him what was likely his best chance of fighting for a world championship.

“If I could have been a world champion, yes, was that my best opportunity? Yeah, absolutely. So from that point of view, I’m like, ‘Yeah, I would have loved to have known another reality of if I stayed.’ I don’t want to say it haunts me, but it’s the one unknown that I’m like, I’m so interested how that would have panned out.”

Ricciardo was careful not to claim he would have beaten Verstappen, saying it would be “unfair” to suggest that. But he did insist that he was still at the top of his game at the time, proven by his win at the Monaco Grand Prix and his pole position in Mexico that year.
Daniel Ricciardo, McLaren, takes a photo on stage at the Miami Opening Party, in front of Zak Brown, CEO, McLaren Racing, Lando Norris, McLaren

“I’m not doubting my abilities to have kept competing with Max,” he said. “It’s clear that from that point on, yes, my career took some... the river was a little windy and rough. So, yeah, that was a pivotal moment.”

He added: “If I could relive it again, would I stay? And am I absolutely curious about what would have happened? Yes, the answer is yes. So if you want to call it regret or curiosity or whatever, then I will say yes.”

Ricciardo later returned to the Red Bull family, first as a reserve driver in 2023 and then racing for its second team, before being dropped after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix after a turbulent time at the outfit.

items.originalTitle: FIA to use AI to help shape future F1 regulations in new AWS partnership
items.summaryEn: The FIA has signed a global partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and will use its artificial intelligence technology to help draw up the rules for Formula 1's next era of cars.
detailZh: 国际汽联将利用亚马逊云科技（AWS）的人工智能协助制定F1未来规则，此前已与这家科技巨头签署新的全球合作伙伴协议。
国际汽联已与亚马逊云科技合作，在制定未来F1规则时使用人工智能。
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
国际汽车联合会（FIA）在与这家科技巨头签署新的全球合作伙伴协议后，将使用亚马逊云科技（AWS）的人工智能来帮助制定F1下一代赛车的规则。
根据该协议，AWS 成为该管理机构的官方人工智能与云计算合作伙伴，其技术将应用于包括 F1 在内的各项赛车运动。
最大的变化将体现在未来规则的制定方式上。国际汽联已经使用 AWS 的计算能力来运行其空气动力学模拟。如今，AWS 还将让国际汽联的技术与工程人员使用人工智能工具，以帮助他们起草规则。
“技术正在改变我们这项运动的每一个环节，国际汽联必须引领这一变革，”国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆解释道。
“我们与 AWS 的新合作将支持从未来赛车到基层俱乐部的一切，许多职业生涯正是从这些基层俱乐部起步。通过将世界一流的云与人工智能技术引入国际汽联的核心，我们可以让车手、官员和志愿者更简便地参与其中，帮助我们的会员俱乐部更高效地运作，并更接近我们让全球赛车运动参与人数翻倍的雄心。我很高兴欢迎 AWS 加入国际汽联大家庭。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆，国际汽联主席
AWS 全球赛事、体育与娱乐总监克里斯汀·沙夫补充道：“赛车运动是世界上要求最高、数据最丰富的环境之一，而国际汽联正处在其中心——管理这项运动、制定规则，并为人们在各个层面参与创造机会。”
“我们很自豪成为国际汽联的官方人工智能合作伙伴，并带来 AWS 的云与人工智能能力，在赛事的各个层面支持他们的使命。”
AWS 还将成为国际汽联颁奖典礼以及国际汽联可持续创新系列的官方合作伙伴。
detailEn: FIA to use AI to help shape future F1 regulations in new AWS partnership
The FIA has partnered with Amazon Web Services to use artificial intelligence in developing future Formula 1 regulations
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

The Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA) will use artificial intelligence from Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help draw up the rules for Formula 1's next era of cars, after signing a new global partnership with the tech giant.
Under the deal, AWS becomes the governing body's official AI and cloud computing partner, with its technology to be used across motorsport, including F1.

The biggest change will be felt in how future rules are written. The FIA already uses AWS computing power to run its aerodynamic simulations. Now, AWS will also give the FIA's technical and engineering staff access to AI tools to help them draw up regulations.
"Technology is changing every part of our sport, and the FIA must lead that change," FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem explained.

"Our new partnership with AWS will support everything from the cars of the future to the grassroots clubs where so many careers begin. By bringing world-class cloud and AI technology into the heart of the FIA, we can make it simpler for drivers, officials and volunteers to take part, help our Member Clubs work more efficiently, and move closer to our ambition of doubling global motor sport participation. I am delighted to welcome AWS to the FIA family."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Mohammed Ben Sulayem, FIA President

Global director of events, sports and entertainment at AWS, Kristin Shaff, added: "Motor sport is one of the most demanding and data-rich environments in the world, and the FIA sits at the center of it — governing the sport, shaping the regulations, and creating opportunities for people to participate at every level.
"We're proud to become the FIA's official AI partner and bring AWS's cloud and AI capabilities to support their mission, across every level of the sport."
AWS will also become an official partner of the FIA Awards and of the FIA Sustainable Innovation Series.
keyPointsZh: AWS成为国际汽联的官方人工智能与云计算合作伙伴
相关技术将应用于包括赛车运动在内的多个领域
keyPointsEn: AWS becomes the governing body's official AI and cloud computing partner.
Its technology will be used across motorsport and other areas.

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner addresses past misconduct allegations in new interview
items.summaryEn: Fifteen months after leaving Red Bull Racing, Christian Horner has spoken publicly for the first time about the misconduct allegations made against him during his tenure, addressing them with defiance in an interview with 60 Minutes Australia.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳在新采访中回应了此前的不当行为指控
克里斯蒂安·霍纳已就其在红牛任职期间针对他的不当行为指控作出回应
克里斯蒂安·霍纳，红牛车队领队
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
尽管克里斯蒂安·霍纳已被证明没有任何不当行为，但围绕他在红牛车队最后几个月的指控仍然引发车迷们的质疑。如今，在他离开车队15个月后，霍纳终于首次打破沉默，谈及那段时光。
在接受澳大利亚《60分钟》节目采访时，这位前车队领队以毫不妥协的强硬态度回应了这些指控。
2023年12月，一名女员工针对霍纳提出正式申诉，指控其存在不当和控制性行为。经过外部专业大律师进行的大规模独立调查，红牛有限公司于2024年2月28日正式证明霍纳没有任何不当行为。
事情并未就此结束。在他被证明清白后仅24小时，一封匿名邮件被泄露给数百名F1记者、车队领队和国际汽联高管，其中包含一个文件，内有79张据称是霍纳与投诉人之间的WhatsApp聊天截图。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳，红牛车队领队
霍纳坚持自己的清白立场，毫不退让。
“听着，我否认所有针对我的指控，”霍纳在直播中坚定地表示。
在最初的澄清之后，投诉人提出了正式上诉，从而触发了第二次调查。2024年8月8日，红牛有限公司宣布，第二位独立律师也驳回了上诉，第二次完全洗清了霍纳的罪名。
当被问及是否有任何遗憾，或者是否希望自己当初以不同方式处理那段动荡时期时，霍纳没有退缩。
“我认为关于这件事，大概已经写得够多、说得够多了……对我来说，现在重要的是向前看，而不是向后看，”霍纳说。“所以没有遗憾。你看，我认为，正如我所说，我遵循了程序；我相信这个程序；它两次被驳回。你继续前进，你知道，你专注于你人生、职业生涯中的下一个挑战，当然还有家庭的优先事项。”
在整个磨难过程中，霍纳与妻子、前辣妹组合成员杰里·哈利维尔展现出团结一致的形象，最引人注目的是在2024年巴林大奖赛上，匿名泄露事件刚见诸报端后，两人手牵手走过围场。
回顾往事，霍纳将当时围绕此事的大部分轰动效应归因于他备受瞩目的婚姻，以及Netflix的《极速求生》所助推的超常名人地位。
杰里·哈利维尔、克里斯蒂安·霍纳、红牛车队、《极速求生》第七季
“显然，作为一个公众人物、一对公众夫妻，不可避免地会有媒体关注围绕这件事……那段时间确实有大量关注，”霍纳承认。“突然间你就从体育版内页登上了头版……[娶了一位辣妹组合成员]并没有帮上忙。突然间，这反而让事情更加火上浇油。”
红牛最终在2025年7月解除了霍纳的职务，此前经历了一连串内部权力斗争以及赛道成绩的下滑，但人们仍预计他会以某种方式重返围场。
detailEn: Christian Horner addresses past misconduct allegations in new interview
Christian Horner has addressed the misconduct allegations made against him during his Red Bull tenure
Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The allegations surrounding Christian Horner's final months at Red Bull Racing still draw questions from fans despite him being cleared of any wrongdoing. Now, 15 months after his exit from the team, Horner has finally broken his silence on that time.
Sitting down with 60 Minutes Australia, the former team principal addressed the allegations with uncompromising defiance.

In December 2023, a female employee lodged a formal grievance against Horner regarding inappropriate and controlling behaviour. Following a massive independent investigation by an external specialist barrister, Red Bull GmbH officially cleared Horner of any wrongdoing on 28 February 2024.

The story did not end there. Barely 24 hours after he was cleared, an anonymous email containing a file of 79 alleged WhatsApp screenshots between Horner and the complainant was leaked to hundreds of F1 journalists, team principals and FIA executives.
Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing
Horner maintains a hardline stance on his innocence.
"Look, I deny any accusations that have been made against me," Horner stated firmly during the broadcast.

Following the initial clearance, the complainant lodged a formal appeal, which triggered a secondary investigation. On 8 August 2024, Red Bull GmbH announced that a second independent lawyer had also dismissed the appeal, fully exonerating Horner for a second time.
When asked if he had any regrets or wished he had handled the turbulent period differently, Horner did not flinch.

"I think probably enough has been written and said about it... for me it's about looking forward rather than backwards now," Horner said. "So no regrets. Look, I think, as I say, I followed the process; I believed in the process; it was dismissed twice. You move, you know, you focus on the next challenges in your life, your career, and obviously the priorities of your family."

Throughout the ordeal, Horner presented a united front with his wife, former Spice Girl Geri Halliwell, most notably walking hand-in-hand down the paddock at the 2024 Bahrain Grand Prix immediately after the anonymous leak hit the press.
Looking back, Horner attributes much of the sensationalism surrounding that time to his high-profile marriage and his outsized celebrity status fuelled by Netflix's Drive to Survive.
Geri Halliwell, Christian Horner, Red Bull Racing, Drive to Survive Season 7

"Obviously as a public person, as a public couple, inevitably there was going to be media attention around it... of which there was significant in that period," Horner admitted. "Suddenly you go from the back pages to the front pages... [marrying a Spice Girl] didn't help. Suddenly that then turbocharged it."
Red Bull ultimately dropped Horner in July 2025 following a string of internal power struggles and a dip in track performance, but a return to the paddock is still expected in one way or another.
